description: The line plot titled "BBQ" illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for different methods. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250 demonstrations. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," is also a linear scale ranging from 45 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5 accuracy points. The plot features four lines representing different methods: "Squared Exponential," "Tanh," "ELU," and "LLdMA-2 chat-7B." The "Squared Exponential" line is solid and colored blue, showing a slight increase in accuracy as the number of demonstrations increases, starting at approximately 55 and ending near 55. The "Tanh" line is also solid and blue, with a similar trend, starting and ending around 55. The "ELU" line is dashed and colored blue, with a slight decline in accuracy, starting just above 50 and ending just below 50. The "LLdMA-2 chat-7B" line is dashed and colored red, with a consistent accuracy level around 45 throughout the number of demonstrations.
